title: Plancherel identity on the binary cube
statement: For every $n\ge 0$ and all real-valued functions $f,g$ on $\mathbb F_2^n$, their uniform average product satisfies $\mathbb E_x[f(x)g(x)]=\sum_{S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}\widehat f(S)\widehat g(S)$, where $\widehat f(S)=\mathbb E_x[f(x)(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}]$ and likewise for $g$.
